commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; IDF="$HOME/esp/esp-idf"; test -f "$IDF/export.sh"; . "$IDF/export.sh" >/dev/null; VERSION=$(idf.py --version); printf 'IDF_VERSION=%s
' "$VERSION"; printf 'IDF_GIT_DESCRIBE=%s
' "$(git -C "$IDF" describe --tags --always --dirty)"; printf 'IDF_HEAD=%s
' "$(git -C "$IDF" rev-parse HEAD)"; case "$VERSION" in *v5.5.4*) printf 'ESP_IDF_5_5_4_CONFIRMED
';; *) exit 7;; esac
